content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":true,"reason":"Same business: online car marketplace selling dealer listings, advertising and software to franchised and independent car dealers."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Insurance claims and total-loss software sold to insurers and repair shops, not dealer marketplace advertising."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Salvage and total-loss vehicle auctions and yards earning per-vehicle fees, not dealer listings or advertising."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Consumer insurance quote marketplace selling leads to insurers and agencies, not automotive dealer marketplace."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Collector car insurance and memberships sold to enthusiasts; it is a regulated insurer, not a dealer-facing marketplace."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Point-of-sale hardware and payments for restaurants and retailers, with no automotive marketplace or dealer advertising."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Diversified news, book publishing and property portals; its listings serve real estate, not car dealers."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Publisher of sports and lifestyle media earning ad and affiliate revenue, not a dealer-facing automotive marketplace."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Software and marketing for small local service businesses, not automotive dealers or a car marketplace."}]}
